scope: Eighteen fixture benchmarks plus one native Panda gripper contact task with a Cartesian wrist fixture; estimated hardware properties, no articulated arm or cable load physics.

native_gripper.scope: Native MuJoCo contact task; Cartesian wrist fixture, no articulated arm

visible_contact_overlay.method: Count orange pixels in the instrument viewport after waiting for a newly requested GPU frame to complete; compare normal and enabled contact-shape views.

rendering.interactive: Scene reflections on the bench and selected instrument planes; per-objective local captures on Nikon, transfer, Zeiss and probe; existing soft lighting and cavity shading
rendering.display: Blender 4.2.8 AgX Medium High Contrast, exposure -0.15 EV
rendering.photo: Unchanged progressive WebGL path tracing of the current paused pose
limitations: Live captures approximate single-bounce radiance; Cycles has more complete light transport.
Planar captures cover the bench and up to two selected instrument planes with approximate directional roughness filtering.
Local objective probes cover four instruments and use approximate anisotropy without per-pixel parallax.
Objective captures refresh incrementally and reflected motion can lag by several frames.
Photo mode pauses physics and approximates directional brushed-metal anisotropy isotropically.
Cable meshes remain prescribed visual deformations without flexible-body contact or tension dynamics.

preserved_evidence.note: Physics, contact-task, source-model and still-render evidence is carried forward only after byte-identity verification; this is a renderer revision.
